title: MoEDDI: Semantic Mixtures of Experts for Long Tailed Drug Drug Interaction Prediction
summary: Descriptor-based drug--drug interaction (DDI) models typically apply a single global predictor despite heterogeneous physicochemical evidence and severely long-tailed labels. We introduce \textbf{MoEDDI (Mixture-of-Experts for Drug--Drug Interaction prediction)}, a chemically organized mixture-of-experts that routes overlapping descriptor families using low-dimensional statistics and combines their sparse top-$2$ mixture with a global T-DDI pathway through a residual logit correction. The residual parameterization can exactly preserve a supplied T-DDI checkpoint at initialization, although the evaluated models are trained from scratch. Across complete test partitions with 178, 86, and 92 classes, MoEDDI improves macro-F1 over reproduced seed-2026 T-DDI baselines from 0.8284 to 0.8485, 0.4729 to 0.6536, and 0.1807 to 0.4671. On the 3,780-feature corpus, the lowest-support group (89 classes with fewer than 50 test examples) shows the largest mean classwise gain (+3.30 F1 points). Calibration improves on one corpus but worsens on two. These single-seed results support semantic conditional specialization while motivating matched ablations and distribution-shift evaluation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MoEDDI，用化学组织化的混合专家模型做长尾药物相互作用预测：以低维统计量为重叠的描述符家族做路由，稀疏 top-2 专家混合再经残差 logit 修正与全局 T-DDI 通路融合，在三个大规模类别划分上提升 macro-F1。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理主线无直接关系，但其稀疏条件路由与「残差保留基模型」的参数化，或可为 LVR 中动态计算分配、以及在叠加 latent 分支时保持原有视觉通路行为提供可供核查的线索。

title: Unified dynamics of training, learning, inference, and reinforcement in neural networks
summary: Despite their remarkable success, neural networks remain largely black boxes, and the mechanisms underlying their behavior are still poorly understood. Nine nanoGPT experiments established training-learning-inference relations: realized updates elicit state-dependent finite-amplitude responses; learning persistently reorganizes distributed functional support, with target-specific readout-boundary crossings determining capability transitions; inference recruits learned support without changing the learned state. Factors identified in the fifth experiment yielded a direct predictor of post-update capability transitions, achieving 91.43% accuracy and 91.49% four-way macro recall across 5,088 targets. We tested these relations and prediction across five additional neural architectures. In a seventh system, concentrated correct feedback eroded previously mastered skills; rebalanced feedback restored their accuracy from 70.31% to 99.48%. Linking inference consequences to subsequent training closes these relations into unified training-learning-inference-reinforcement dynamics.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文以九个 nanoGPT 实验刻画训练、学习、推理与强化反馈之间的统一动态，提出能力转变可由读出边界跨越预测，并跨多种架构检验，还展示反馈失衡导致已掌握技能退化及再平衡后的恢复。
AI.relevance_reason: 文中「推理动用已学支持但不改变学习状态」与读出边界、反馈侵蚀技能的描述，可能为核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真正被更新、以及轨迹训练与 RL 反馈的贡献分配提供线索。

title: MAPLE: A Multimodal Mobile Agent with Playbook-Learned Experience
summary: Autonomous agents powered by vision-language models (VLMs) show great potential in navigating mobile graphical user interfaces (GUIs) to complete complex tasks. However, existing paradigms face fundamental scalability bottlenecks: fine-tuning requires massive high-fidelity datasets or prohibitive training time and compute, while gradient-free approaches rely on custom static heuristics or costly trial-and-error trajectory exploration where feedback is deferred until the end of execution. To address these limitations, we introduce MAPLE (Multimodal Agent with Playbook-Learned Experience), a novel gradient-free multi-agent framework that enables dynamic, step-wise experience sharing and execution-time prompt evolution. Unlike traditional action-reflection architectures that depend on costly, post-hoc self-reflection, MAPLE enables agents to cross-reference and distribute runtime insights in real time at each operational step. This dynamic exchange eliminates blind trial-and-error looping and steers agents along direct, grounded interaction paths. Extensive evaluations on the AndroidWorld and MobileWorld benchmarks demonstrate that MAPLE achieves state-of-the-art performance on complex, long-horizon mobile tasks, while proving scalable and adaptable across novel environments.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MAPLE，一个免梯度的多智能体移动端 GUI 智能体框架，通过跨智能体在每一步实时共享运行时经验并动态演化执行期提示，替代后验自我反思，在 AndroidWorld 与 MobileWorld 上取得较强的长程任务表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「经验手册 + 逐步提示演化」可视为一种外置的推理期状态更新与经验复用机制，可供核查是否能对照 LVR 中无梯度的状态更新、经验积累与停止决策；但论文不涉及 latent 表示或视觉信息保留的分析，线索偏边缘。

title: FACET: Feasibility-Automaton Complete Enumeration and Truncation-Free Scoring of Molecular Formulas from MS/MS
summary: Determining the neutral molecular formula of a precursor ion from its tandem mass (MS/MS) spectrum is the first step in identifying an unknown small molecule. Existing methods trade recall, whether the correct formula is among the candidates, against the cost of examining each candidate. Methods that examine each candidate in depth must first shorten the list, by limiting element counts or truncating it, and that is where the correct formula is lost. End-to-end regressors are fast but guarantee neither validity nor recall. We present FACET, which separates deciding which formulas to consider from deciding which one to choose. A feasibility automaton builds a formula one element count at a time and admits exactly the formulas that fit the precursor mass and satisfy the ring-and-double-bond and valence constraints. Run as an exhaustive search, it enumerates the complete feasible set, so every candidate is valid and recall is fixed by the chemical constraints rather than by a trained model. A small neural scoring head then ranks every feasible formula from one pass of a pretrained spectrum encoder, so no candidate is discarded. On the NPLIB1 benchmark FACET reaches top-1 accuracies of $0.859$ with the adduct known and $0.729$ with it unknown, compared with $0.766$ and $0.660$ for the strongest established method, and its recall is the highest. On the external CASMI 2022 set its recall is $1.000$, and with the adduct unknown it is the most accurate of the methods compared.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FACET，将「决定考虑哪些候选分子式」与「决定选哪一个」解耦：用可行性自动机按元素计数逐步构造，穷举满足母离子质量与价键约束的全部可行式，再由小型神经打分头基于一次谱图编码器前向对全候选排序，在 NPLIB1 与 CASMI 2022 上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「完整枚举候选、不截断地对全部候选打分」的解耦思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中多 latent 假设生成与视觉证据筛选、以及避免早期剪枝造成信息坍缩的问题；但研究领域为质谱分子式识别，与视觉推理仅有方法层面的间接联系。

title: Learning by Doing: Autonomously Compiling and Curating Agent Skills from Verified Traces
summary: Memory systems for production LLM agents mostly store semantic memory (facts about users and domains) or episodic memory (earlier interactions). Research systems such as Trace2Skill, WikiSkill, and SkillRevise learn procedures from agent runs, package them as Skills, and evaluate them on benchmarks. We describe Zep Agent Skills, a production service that gives deployed agents this procedural memory. The service uses only verified attempts as evidence, cites the supporting events for each field of a Skill, and governs the admission and distribution of each Skill version. The service records each task attempt as a Trace with ordered events, an outcome, and a verification strength. A compiler with separate Reflector and Curator roles turns verified Traces into versioned Skills. Scans and admission gates control which candidates become active, and verified use outcomes change the search rank of each Skill. The Agent Skills format is an open standard that Anthropic originated and donated to the Agentic AI Foundation, so any host of the format can load a compiled Skill. Agents retrieve Skills through lexical search with progressive disclosure, over an API or MCP. We evaluate Zep Agent Skills on $τ^3$-bench banking, AppWorld, and EnterpriseOps-Gym. Skills compiled from the Traces of a teacher model increase the pass rate of three weaker executor models on the same tasks, at every reasoning effort, by 4.5 to 18.8 points. Most of the gain is on the tasks that the teacher solved. On ALFWorld, Skills compiled from the runs of a small model give a gain similar to or larger than the gain that prior work reports for continuous fine-tuning, with no training.

AI.brief_summary: 该文介绍 Zep Agent Skills 生产服务：把带验证强度的 agent 尝试轨迹经 Reflector 与 Curator 编译为带版本、准入与分发控制的 Skills，并按验证结果调整检索排序，在多个文本 agent 基准上以弱执行模型评估其收益。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本 agent 程序性记忆，与视觉推理无直接关联；但「只把已验证轨迹当监督证据、按验证结果更新技能检索排序、渐进披露取用」可能为 LVR 的轨迹监督、贡献分配与证据筛选提供可核查线索。

title: When Should an Agent Refresh? Adaptive Index Reuse for Efficient Long-Horizon Reasoning
summary: Language agents read code, tool output, and dialogue in contexts that grow at every step. Dynamic sparse attention lets a small indexer choose the earlier tokens each query attends to, but the indexer still scores the whole prefix at every layer. Cross-layer reuse methods such as IndexCache rerun the indexer at only some layers, with one fixed pattern for every input. In an agent, the relevant evidence can change abruptly when a traceback or test result arrives, so fresh selections matter more at some steps than at others. We propose Adaptive Index Reuse (AIR), which keeps IndexCache's execution and learns, for each segment of an agent episode, how many layers refresh their selection. A small controller reads signals from completed computation and the latest tool event, chooses a pattern from a nested library, and learns from terminal task reward under an expected compute budget. On Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 with a 128K context, AIR improves success over the strongest static schedule at matched cost on SWE-bench Verified (27.0% to 32.4%), Terminal-Bench 2.0, and three $τ^2$-bench domains, and it lowers time per successful task on all five. Across 50 backbone, context, and benchmark settings, it matches or exceeds that schedule in 44.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 AIR：针对长程语言 agent 的动态稀疏注意力，用一个读取已完成计算与最新工具事件的小型控制器，按 episode 片段学习刷新索引的层数，在给定算力预算下以最终任务奖励训练，从而在匹配成本时提升 SWE-bench Verified 等任务成功率并降低单任务耗时。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「何时重新刷新证据选择、刷新多少」的预算约束学习控制器，可能与 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 式证据再获取与动态算力分配问题相通，可供核查；但该工作只处理文本 agent 的注意力索引效率，未涉及视觉状态或 latent 推理表示。

title: I-PTC: Interactive Programmatic Tool Calling for Stateful Tool-Augmented Agents
summary: Large language models are increasingly capable of writing and executing code, suggesting a natural paradigm for tool-augmented agents: expressing tool use as programs rather than isolated calls. Programmatic tool calling (PTC) captures this idea through loops, batching, abstraction, and structured computation, but existing PTC approaches are largely stateless, limiting their ability to reuse intermediate results and adapt over time. This is problematic for real-world tasks, where tool environments and problem-solving processes are inherently stateful. We therefore present I-PTC, an interactive framework that executes stateful PTC: models issue code snippets that call tools, maintain reusable state, and evolve the tool interface through API corrections. To evaluate the effectiveness of I-PTC and the general PTC setting, we introduce PTC-Bench, a benchmark of long-tail, production-style user requests whose difficulty comes from large initial environments, many dependent API interactions, extended planning, and recovery across follow-ups and transient failures. Experiments on PTC-Bench show that I-PTC improves performance on complex multi-step tasks with large tool sets while substantially reducing token consumption over conventional tool-calling baselines and the original PTC baseline, highlighting stateful programmatic tool calling as a promising direction for scalable tool-augmented agents.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 I-PTC 交互式框架，让模型以代码片段调用工具、维护可复用状态并通过 API 修正演化工具接口，同时构建 PTC-Bench 长尾生产式请求基准，实验显示复杂多步任务性能提升且 token 消耗显著下降。
AI.relevance_reason: 其跨轮保留中间状态、按需修正接口的机制，可供核查是否能为 VLM 推理中的外部证据积累、状态更新与继续或停止判断提供可借鉴的外部化方案，但与 latent 表示和视觉细节保留无直接联系。

title: CONFIRM: Governing Scientific Reporting for Trustworthy Agentic Neuroimaging
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can autonomously run neuroimaging analyses from research questions to reported findings. Existing agentic systems use tools to check that code runs and reported values match its output, but rely on LLM judgment to decide which results warrant scientific reporting. We show that LLM judges endorse site-confounded findings even when the confound is presented as evidence. We present \textbf{CONFIRM}, a framework that separates running an analysis from deciding which findings to report. CONFIRM encodes each hypothesis as a machine-readable, pre-specified analysis plan that fixes the claim and its pass criteria before computing results. It then filters results through five deterministic gates (search history and multiplicity, confounds, power, analytic stability, and replication) under three configurable reporting standards, from least to most demanding: \textit{Screen}, \textit{Replicate}, and \textit{Full}. Failed claims receive diagnoses that guide follow-up analyses. To evaluate reporting decisions at the claim level, we introduce \textbf{NeuroClaimBench}, comprising 489 executable neuroimaging claims with frozen data, including literature-supported findings and 150 controls designed to violate individual methodological requirements. On NeuroClaimBench, CONFIRM falsely supports at most 3\% of controls, compared with 23--38\% for the baselines, while recovering up to 61\% of literature-supported claims. When auditing an existing agent, CONFIRM reduces false support on controls from 23\% to 0\% while retaining the agent's literature-supported claims. Its diagnostic feedback also produces more supported revisions than Self-Refine with fewer LLM calls. Together, CONFIRM and NeuroClaimBench show that basing reporting decisions on pre-specified analysis plans and deterministic gates is essential for trustworthy autonomous scientific discovery.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对神经影像 LLM agent 自动分析中"哪些结果值得报告"由 LLM 判断导致混杂结论被采纳的问题，提出 CONFIRM：把假设预先写成机器可读的分析计划并固定通过标准，再用多重性、混杂、检验力、稳定性、复现五道确定性门过滤结果并给出失败诊断，同时发布 NeuroClaimBench。
AI.relevance_reason: 其"预注册判定标准+确定性门+失败诊断"机制可能为 LVR 中筛选视觉/证据支撑、决定是否采信与停止的条件化判定提供借鉴线索，但本文不涉及多模态推理或 latent 状态，需核查可迁移性。

title: ContactCut: A Partition-Aware Contact Selection Framework for False-Merge Correction in Connectomics
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to the IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI) 2027
summary: Localized false-merge correction in connectomics requires converting an identified error into an executable native 3D partition. Still, neither intermediate correction predictions nor seeded graph solvers alone determine which native source-sink constraints should define that partition. We formulate this problem as a 3D-native partition-aware contact selection problem: selecting candidate contacts based on the complete partitions they induce. Our solution comprises two components: ContactCut (CC)-Auto, which uses learned single-contact selection, and ContactCut (CC)-Search, which enables bounded paired-contact search, generates compact alternatives, and applies learned panel ranking. On historical two-way false-merge corrections from MICrONS and FlyWire, CC-Auto improves failure-aware 3D partition (FA-3D Part.) mIoU by 5.9 and 3.4 points over the strongest graph-based controls and by 12.5 and 10.0 points over the best learned baselines. A MICrONS-trained ranker transfers to FlyWire with negligible degradation. CC-Search expands oracle reachability and prioritizes near-oracle alternatives. The code is available at https://github.com/bentake/ContactCut.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把连接组学中的局部误合并纠正表述为「依据候选接触所诱导的完整 3D 分区来做选择」的问题，提出 CC-Auto（学习式单接触选择）与 CC-Search（有界成对接触搜索生成紧凑备选并做学习式面板排序），在 MICrONS 与 FlyWire 的纠正数据上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 按候选所诱导的下游结果而非局部打分来筛选，并用学习排序器在有限备选面板中比较方案，可能为 LVR 中多条 latent 假设与视觉证据的筛选和验证提供方法线索，可供核查其迁移性。

title: Can Large Language Model Agents Learn by Watching Tutorial Videos?
summary: Humans continuously acquire knowledge from carefully crafted materials such as books and tutorial videos, carrying that understanding into future tasks. Millions of such instructional videos are uploaded online every day, yet LLM agents remain unable to exploit this ever-expanding wealth of human teaching. Their capabilities are frozen after training, while parameter updates at scale remain prohibitively expensive. This raises the central question: can LLM agents learn from this vast instructional resource without parameter updates? We introduce Tutorial Agentic Learning (TAL), a nonparametric continual-learning paradigm that consolidates tutorial videos into a persistent, structured tutorialbook memory through a two-stage adversarial process that harvests hard, video-grounded questions and uses them to refine the memory. At inference time, TAL retrieves through a Table-of-Contents (TOC) tree, tying retrieval directly to the model's reasoning rather than to embedding similarity. To study this setting, we introduce VidLearn, a multimodal QA benchmark built from 72 chess tutorial videos spanning 12 openings. On VidLearn, TAL outperforms all evaluated baselines and improves monotonically as more videos are consumed, achieving up to 113% and 91% relative gains over the corresponding vanilla MLLMs on the training and test splits, respectively. In actual gameplay, TAL reaches a stronger opening-phase position than its vanilla counterpart in 69% of head-to-head games. Evaluation in a second domain further demonstrates the generality of TAL. Together, these results highlight instructional videos as a scalable resource for parameter-update-free agent continual learning.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 TAL：一种无需参数更新的持续学习范式，把教学视频整理为结构化的 tutorialbook 记忆，并通过两阶段对抗式流程挖掘视频接地的难题来精炼该记忆；同时构建基于 72 个国际象棋教程视频的 VidLearn 基准进行评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 用 TOC 树把检索与推理过程绑定、再以难题筛选精炼外部记忆的做法，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与训练监督提供线索；但其机制依赖非参数化外部记忆而非 latent 状态，迁移可行性有待核查。

title: Causal Optimal-Transport Attention: Positional Priors and Length Extrapolation
summary: Causal masking obstructs the column balancing used by optimal-transport (OT) attention. We study a prefix-consistent unbalanced operator and characterize the positional prior it induces. Under bounded scores, for any fixed balancing strength $ρ<1$, its fixed point dilutes attention: every fixed window receives a vanishing share as the context grows. For constant scores, we derive an exact scale-invariant prior. We then classify positional encodings by whether their distant attention mass remains bounded away from one. Discrete window-mass bounds quantify the finite-length dilution of summable log-distance priors near exponent one. Preregistered experiments with 25M- and 100M-parameter language models establish improved loss extrapolation over softmax; exploratory comparisons favor an explicit distance bias at a fraction of the cost. CABLE outperforms RoPE with evaluation-time YaRN on every seed at three training lengths. Changing only the bias beyond the training length moves long-context loss in the predicted direction on all 30 tested checkpoints. Even with exponents constrained above one, many heads approach the summability boundary during training. A margin selected by prior-only calculations for a specified window, length range and growth tolerance controls distant-mass growth in the tested setting. These results connect loss extrapolation to positional decay over the lengths actually evaluated.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究因果掩码下最优传输注意力的失衡算子及其诱导的位置先验，推导有界分数下注意力随上下文增长被稀释、常数分数下尺度不变先验等结论，并据此分类位置编码、提出 CABLE，用 25M/100M 语言模型的预注册实验检验长度外推。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本、不涉及视觉推理，但其关于注意力结构、远距注意力质量衰减与位置偏置如何影响长度外推的分析，可供核查 LVR 中位置与注意力结构对长序列推理状态的影响。

title: Sweep Less, Steer More: Using Activation Steering Geometry for Reduced Hyperparameter Search
summary: Representation steering methods like difference-in-means (DIM) offer a lightweight approach to controlling LLM behavior, but their effectiveness varies widely across concepts, datasets, and layers, making principled deployment costly without exhaustive hyperparameter sweeps. We build on the discriminability index $d'$, a compute-cheap geometric measure of how well contrastive training activations separate along the steering direction. Across five behaviors on 3 models, we demonstrate uses beyond its established role as a dataset-level steerability predictor. First, in the multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) setting, we show that $d'$ reliably identifies performant layers at which to steer, eliminating the need for a layer-wise sweep. Second, we extend this analysis to open-ended multi-token generation, and find that $d'$ remains successful for layer selection across different settings. Lastly, we test whether the position of a generated token's representation on the DIM line predicts steering success on that individual example. In the MCQA setting, this works for high-$d'$ datasets but is inconsistent across behaviors, models, and training-token choices in open-ended generation. This highlights that methods developed and conclusions drawn in single-token MCQA settings do not necessarily transfer to open-ended generation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究用对比激活沿 steering 方向的可分性指数 d′ 这一廉价几何度量，替代逐层超参数扫描；在 3 个模型的 5 种行为上表明 d′ 可选出有效 steer 层，但单个 token 位置预测 steering 成败仅在 MCQA 高 d′ 数据上成立。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本激活操作，但 d′ 这类廉价可分性统计可供核查能否用于挑选 LVR 中信噪较高的层与 token 位置，其“单 token 结论不迁移到多 token 生成”的负结果也与 latent 相似度的深度、位置效应相关。

title: AR-RRG: Anatomy-Guided Retrieval-Driven Radiology Report Generation
summary: Radiology report generation (RRG) streamlines clinical workflows and alleviates the burden of radiologists' documentation. Standard vision-language models capture global visual cues and lack fine-grained alignment between anatomical regions and diagnostic text. Most retrieval-augmented methods retrieve complete historical reports, introducing redundant noise and severe vision-text mismatches that trigger clinically risky hallucinations and missed lesions. In this paper, we introduce AR-RRG, an anatomy-guided retrieval-driven method for the generation of radiology reports. AR-RRG consists of two core modules: the anatomy-aware self-training lesion detection network (ASLDNet) and the retrieval-driven radiology report generation (RRRG). ASLDNet leverages anatomy-aware spatial verification (ASV) and class-adaptive dynamic thresholding (CDT) via self-training, delivering accurate lesion localization to support subsequent generation. As the generative branch of AR-RRG, RRRG eliminates clinical hallucinations through dual-granularity retrieval (DR) and complements missing lesions with a neighborhood consensus (NC) mechanism. A parallel continuous visual perception (PCVP) stream converts radiographs into visual tokens through fixed medical encoding and resampling. Multi-scale text and visual features are fused, followed by LoRA-efficient large language model tuning to generate clinically consistent, visually grounded radiology reports. Extensive evaluations on MS-CXR, MIMIC-CXR, and IU X-Ray demonstrate that AR-RRG consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across mainstream metrics. Our code will be made publicly available.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AR-RRG：以解剖引导的病灶检测网络 ASLDNet 提供定位，再用双粒度检索与邻域共识机制补充缺失病灶、抑制幻觉，并结合视觉 token 化与 LoRA 微调生成放射报告。
AI.relevance_reason: 双粒度检索与邻域共识可作为「视觉证据筛选与冗余抑制」的具体方法线索，供核查 LVR 中证据选取与幻觉抑制；但该文不涉及 latent 推理状态生成或动态计算，联系仍属间接。

title: MoPort: A View-Aware 2D Interface for Motion Language Models
summary: Motion language models (MoLMs) encode 3D human motion as discrete tokens for language-based understanding. Deploying them on monocular video raises two problems. Pose detection yields 2D joint sequences, leaving a dimensional gap from the 3D motion used in training. Moreover, the 2D observation changes with the camera viewpoint, while the depth lost in projection makes the 2D pose ambiguous across viewpoints. We propose MoPort, a view-aware 2D interface that enables MoLMs to take 2D observations as input. We introduce Paired View Alignment (PVA), which gives two views of the same motion a shared 3D teacher target and directly constrains the consistency of their latents, so that 2D observations from different viewpoints are mapped to a consistent semantic representation. Camera-Modulated Encoding (CME) estimates the camera extrinsics from the 2D sequence and uses them to modulate encoding, providing the 2D latents with geometric information about the viewpoint. MoPort achieves R@1 of 0.5674 on HumanML3D and 0.3286 on KIT-ML, outperforming all evaluated baselines. On HumanML3D, its R@1 decreases only from 0.5763 on in-distribution viewpoints to 0.5585 on out-of-distribution viewpoints. We validate portability on three downstream MoLMs. Furthermore, on the real-world RGB video dataset Fit3D, MoPort achieves 80.36\% accuracy. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.brief_summary: MoPort 为 motion language model 设计视角感知的 2D 接口：用配对视角对齐（PVA）让同一动作的不同视角 2D 观测 latent 对齐到共享 3D 教师目标，并以相机调制编码（CME）从 2D 序列估计外参注入视角几何，在 HumanML3D、KIT-ML 与 Fit3D 上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「哪些信息应跨视角保持不变、哪些几何需显式写入 latent」的训练设计，可能为 LVR 中视角相关视觉证据的保留与信息坍缩提供可核查线索；但研究对象是人体动作 token 理解，与视觉推理主线距离较远。

title: TopoDPO: Dense Preference Alignment for Structure-Sensitive Aerial Referring Segmentation
summary: Preference optimization for multimodal segmentation faces a granularity mismatch: dense masks contain spatially heterogeneous preference signals, whereas image-level objectives assign one shared nonlinear weight to all spatial margins. We introduce TopoDPO, a topology-aware dense preference alignment framework for structure-sensitive aerial referring segmentation. Topo-Prior mines informative preference pairs using connected-component discrepancy and macro-corner recall, while the dense objective applies the preference penalty to each local margin before spatial aggregation against a frozen supervised reference. On Topo-RS-Hard, a 4590-instance structural stress set, TopoDPO improves intersection over union (IoU) from 50.91% to 51.24% over image-level direct preference optimization (DPO) and reduces Betti-0 error from 1.34 to 0.90; paired image-cluster bootstrap intervals against image-level DPO exclude zero for all five reported metrics. Matched supervised controls and a complete factorial analysis separate the effects of topology-aware pair mining, localized correction, and dense reference-relative preference weighting. An unfiltered stratification over all 39,244 validation records further shows the clearest structural gains on samples with moderate or severe pre-alignment component-count errors. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/phy709/TopoDPO.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 TopoDPO，面向结构敏感的航空指代分割，用连通分量差异与大角点召回挖掘偏好对，并把偏好惩罚施加在每个局部 margin 后再空间聚合，以对比冻结的监督参考模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「稠密局部偏好 vs 图像级单一权重」的粒度错配分析，可能可供核查 latent 推理中轨迹级与步骤级贡献分配和监督粒度问题，但论文本身不涉及内部 latent 状态或推理期证据获取。

title: Text-Assisted Event Stream Visual Place Recognition via Multi-Scale Spatiotemporal Optimal Transport
comment: 17 pages including appendix, 4 figures. Submitted to ICLR 2027
summary: Benefiting from the high dynamic range, high temporal resolution, and low energy consumption of event cameras, low-altitude economic research leveraging event cameras has become a popular topic. Several existing attempts introduce natural-language descriptions into visual place recognition (VPR) to mitigate the sparsity of structural spatial information inherent to event cameras. Nevertheless, these methods still fail to fully address two core challenges: effectively encoding event streams and semantically aligning event streams with text. In this paper, we propose a multi-scale spatial-temporal optimal transport approach, MSTOT-EPR, to address these challenges. Specifically, given event streams and scene text information, we first adopt a visual encoder and a text encoder to extract respective feature representations. We then apply optimal-transport constraints to achieve cross-modal alignment. We then design a cross-modal bottleneck fusion module to further fuse bimodal features. Furthermore, we develop multi-scale spatial optimal transport and inter-frame temporal optimal transport modules to mine high-quality spatial-temporal event features for scene recognition. Extensive experiments on the NYC-Event-VPR and EPRBench datasets fully validate the effectiveness of our proposed framework for event-based VPR. The source code of this paper will be released upon acceptance.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MSTOT-EPR：用视觉与文本编码器分别提取事件流与场景文本特征，以最优传输约束做跨模态对齐，再经跨模态瓶颈融合模块，以及多尺度空间与帧间时间最优传输模块，挖掘用于事件相机视觉位置识别的时空特征。
AI.relevance_reason: 任务本身是事件流位置识别而非多模态推理，但其跨模态瓶颈融合与多尺度空间/时间最优传输对齐，可能为核查「视觉证据如何被压缩进 latent 状态、时序证据如何筛选」提供方法线索，值得进一步确认。

title: Meta-memorization and memorization scaling laws in transformers
summary: Larger transformers can memorize more data, with a capacity (in bits) that scales roughly linearly with the number of parameters. Counterintuitively, larger models also memorize faster, requiring fewer repetitions of a sequence during training before it is memorized. We reproduce both memorization scaling laws in transformers trained on random binary sequences, showing that rapid memorization can arise even when data contain no semantic or compositional structure. Rapid memorization is due to a meta-memorization effect, where models trained to memorize a large set of random sequences learn to memorize novel sequences more quickly. The rate $r(t)$ at which models memorize grows with training time $t$ as a power-law $r(t) \sim t^β$ with a fixed exponent $β$ but an increasing upper cutoff across model scales. Meta-memorization enables even one-layer transformers to few-shot memorize a 100-bit sequence. This effect is partly explained by the formation of structured attention heads that convey position-invariant sequence information to MLPs where memorized sequences are stored. Meta-memorization is recapitulated in a simplified model of a dense associative memory where retrieval is constrained by an attentional bottleneck. Our results suggest transformers, through pre-training, acquire reusable mechanisms that enable highly efficient storage and retrieval of memories.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在随机二值序列上复现记忆容量与记忆速度的缩放律，提出「元记忆」效应：模型在大规模随机序列训练中学会更快记忆新序列，并将其部分归因于结构化注意力头向 MLP 传递位置无关的序列信息。
AI.relevance_reason: 「结构化注意力头 + MLP 存储」与「注意力瓶颈约束检索」的机制可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态的读写路径、位置无关内容与深度/位置对表示相似度的影响，以及瓶颈带来的信息压缩；纯文本随机序列任务与视觉推理本身无直接关联。

title: Search-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation with Sibling Alignment for Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommendation retrieves items by autoregressively generating semantic IDs, typically via beam search. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) enhances training supervision by transferring privileged self-teacher knowledge at student-generated states. However, beam-search retention depends on competition among prefixes: visited states differ in importance, and initially reliable decisions may approach the pruning boundary as training evolves. Moreover, conventional distribution matching couples target-token confidence with preferences among competing continuations, potentially weakening relational supervision when the self-teacher strongly favors the target. To address these challenges, we propose Search-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation (SA-OPSD), a framework that transfers privileged self-teacher knowledge to the states visited during the student's own beam search. Specifically, we introduce Evolving-Boundary Sampling, which prioritizes search-critical states by considering both current pruning-boundary proximity and initial-reference retention-margin decline under a controlled distillation budget. Furthermore, we develop Confidence-Decoupled Branch Distillation, which separates target-probability calibration from informative sibling relations to better preserve the teacher's preferences among competing branches. Experiments on Industrial, Office, and Instruments demonstrate strong performance for SA-OPSD.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SA-OPSD，在生成式推荐的 beam search 中向学生自访问状态迁移自教师知识，用「演化边界采样」优先蒸馏关键状态，并用「置信度解耦分支蒸馏」分离目标概率校准与同级分支偏好。
AI.relevance_reason: 非多模态任务，但其按剪枝边界与保留裕度挑选搜索关键状态的思路，可供核查 LVR 中轨迹采样与贡献分配；解耦同级分支关系或可启发 latent 状态偏好监督的设计。

title: Recoverability-Aware Evaluation of Diffusion Video Inpainting and Object Removal
summary: Video inpainting for object removal is scored over the whole hole, although the background behind the object is visible in other frames of the shot for some hole pixels and in no frame for others. A whole-hole score therefore mixes copying with generation and cannot show which of the two a remover does well. To separate the two, we propose recoverability-stratified evaluation, in which a point tracker run on the clean video labels each hole pixel by whether and how far away it is observed, so that fidelity and temporal stability can be reported per stratum against a copy reference. To reuse the observed content, we also propose evidence-guided sampling (EGS), which blends tracked colors into the clean-latent prediction of a video diffusion remover without training. On DAVIS, the perceptual advantage of three diffusion removers over flow propagation shrinks where the content is visible a few frames away (LPIPS difference-in-differences +0.046 to +0.056 against E2FGVI-HQ), and real paired captures show the same pattern for two of them. Their DAVIS hole warping error is two to four times that of ProPainter, and copying along clean-video tracks lowers their recoverable LPIPS by a quarter to two fifths. EGS closes 43% and 56% of the gap to this copy reference on held-out DAVIS when its colors come from clean-video tracks. With colors tracked on the masked input, a pre-registered confirmation finds no gain on MiniMax-Remover and a loss on ROSE. Diffusion removers thus leave observed content unused on DAVIS, and training-free reuse does not yet hold with tracked evidence.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出按「可恢复性」分层的视频物体移除修补评测：用点跟踪器在干净视频上标记每个孔洞像素是否在其他帧被观测到，从而把保真度与时间稳定性按层汇报、并与「直接复制」参考对比；同时提出免训练的 evidence-guided sampling，将跟踪得到的颜色混入视频扩散修补器的 clean-latent 预测。在 DAVIS 上据此指出扩散修补器在可恢复区域未利用已有观测内容。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「把可追踪的像素证据直接注入扩散 latent 预测」以及按证据可用性分层评价的思路，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据注入、latent 状态是否真正使用观测细节、以及视觉旁路评测设计的线索；但研究对象是视频修补而非推理，联系需较多核查。

title: NatureFusion: Rethinking Infrared and Visible Image Fusion as Natural Complementary Enhancement
summary: In the absence of ground truth, most existing infrared and visible image fusion methods pursue fidelity to the source images and directly superimpose two physically distinct modalities. As a result, salient infrared targets appear as bright patches of thermal radiation pasted onto the scene. These patches obscure the original color and texture of the targets, so the fused images look unnatural to human observers and deviate from the data distribution learned by vision models pretrained on visible images. Therefore, we redefine infrared and visible image fusion as natural complementary enhancement rather than source fidelity, and propose NatureFusion, which exploits cross-modal complementary cues to infer a clear and natural visible-style image from low-quality visible and infrared image pairs. Specifically, to address the lack of ground truth, we employ a generative foundation model as the teacher to directly generate visually natural fused images for supervision. Furthermore, to fully distill the teacher's generative capability while reducing computational cost, we fine-tune a pretrained generative model with conditional flow matching through a light-weight fusion adapter. Last but not least, to further improve downstream performance without sacrificing natural appearance, we freeze the fusion adapter and introduce a detector-supervised task adapter that strengthens the complementary contribution of infrared. Extensive comparisons with seven multi-modal fusion and seven single-modality enhancement methods demonstrate that NatureFusion generates visually natural fused images with the best perceptual quality. Detection and segmentation models pretrained on visible images achieve substantially higher accuracy on our fused images than on those of any competing method.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 NatureFusion，把红外与可见光图像融合重新定义为自然互补增强：以生成基础模型作教师，为无真值场景产生视觉自然的融合图作为监督，并用条件 flow matching 经轻量融合适配器蒸馏，再在冻结适配器上加入检测器监督的任务适配器。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用生成教师构造无真值监督、以轻量适配器注入跨模态互补线索的安排，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与监督信号构造；但论文产出是图像级融合结果，不含推理状态生成，联系需较多核查。

title: Seeing What Matters, Verifying What Pays: Load-Adaptive Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates vision-language model (VLM) inference without altering the output distribution, yet two factors limit its gains. Existing drafters either lack the image evidence required for visually grounded tokens or pay to condition on every visual token, although a short draft block typically depends on only a few image regions. Moreover, the value of verifying additional candidates varies with GPU load, so no fixed verification structure is efficient across serving conditions. We present Uni-LaSpec, a block-parallel speculative decoding framework that addresses both factors. To improve draft quality, Uni-LaSpec reuses the verifier's own attention: the query retained from the preceding verification ranks the cached, int8-quantized visual keys, and a cross-layer vote selects a few visual tokens that the drafter fuses through gated cross-attention. Acceptance-aware training further weights each draft position by its contribution to the accepted prefix. To allocate verification, a marginal-cost criterion selects the structure per request and per round: draft trees exploit idle verifier capacity under light load, whereas a dynamic head truncates linear drafts under heavy load. Across six VLMs from three model families and 17 text and multimodal benchmarks, selecting eight visual tokens retains at least 98.6% of the acceptance obtained from the full image at sub-millisecond selection cost. With greedy decoding at concurrency one, Uni-LaSpec achieves up to 5.11x text and 3.24x multimodal throughput over autoregressive decoding. Across six load levels and three GPU types, it outperforms autoregressive decoding in every setting and matches or exceeds the best fixed verification strategy in 123 of 144 settings; under bursty arrivals, it reduces mean end-to-end latency by 47.6% relative to linear verification.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Uni-LaSpec 块并行投机解码框架：复用验证器的注意力查询与跨层投票，从 int8 量化的视觉 key 中挑出少量视觉 token 供 drafter 通过门控交叉注意力融合，并按边际成本在线选择验证结构（轻载用 draft 树、重载截断线性 draft），在六个 VLM 上提速并降低时延。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按验证器注意力筛选少量视觉证据、以及按边际成本动态决定验证深度/截断的做法，与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选和「算多少、何时停」的计算分配问题可供核查对应；但论文目标是推理加速而非 latent 推理，联系需自行判断。

title: Local or Escalate? Post-Training Expert Routing for Real-Time Duplex Speech Models
summary: A full-duplex model should answer easy questions immediately, but hard questions often need stronger reasoning, which may require waiting. The challenge is to choose between these paths at the moment the model begins to speak. Recent systems learn related mode decisions through special-token generation inside the dialogue model, coupling routing to turn-taking and temporally annotated full-duplex training. We study a post-training alternative. We freeze MiniCPM-o 4.5, using only its speech input and output, and fit a logistic failure readout on hidden states already available at its native listen-to-speak transition. The resulting gate requires no additional model generation and exposes thresholds that can be retuned without changing the duplex policy. A probe fitted on text-input states also reads the states of spoken questions, including unseen human recordings. On the internal benchmark, selective handoff improves answer accuracy by 27.1 points. Compared with always using the expert, it reduces mean server time to first answer audio by 31.5 percent. It also outperforms matched random routing across external speech question-answering pools, as well as a zero-shot GPT-5.4 mini router that rates the transcribed question. The training recipe also transfers to a second duplex model family. These results show that an existing duplex model can be equipped to answer easy turns immediately and wait for stronger reasoning or fresher knowledge on the turns that need it, without further duplex training.

AI.brief_summary: 论文冻结 MiniCPM-o 4.5 全双工语音模型，在其「听转说」时刻的已有隐状态上拟合 logistic 失败读出，用于决定即时作答还是转交更强的专家推理，并在内部基准与外部语音问答集上验证该后训练门控的效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 从冻结模型内部状态轻量读出「是否需要更多推理」的门控思路，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/STOP 与计算升级决策提供可核查线索；但对象是全双工语音而非视觉，跨模态与跨任务可迁移性待判断。

title: UA-Depth: Uncertainty-Aware Depth Restoration for Material-Agnostic Object Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation requires accurate metric depth, yet commodity RGB-D cameras often fail on non-Lambertian objects such as transparent, reflective, and translucent materials, producing holes, structured noise, and biased depth. Most restoration methods produce only a single depth map, treating noisy and reliable regions uniformly for downstream tasks while ignoring regional uncertainty. We present UA-Depth, an uncertainty-aware depth restoration framework that iteratively co-refines depth and pixel-wise uncertainty, and uses uncertainty-gated features to suppress unreliable cues for stable updates. To strengthen zero-shot behavior, UA-Depth leverages a frozen depth foundation model as a prior to initialize missing or unreliable depth, and applies two-stage MAD-weighted log-depth scale normalization to reduce outlier bias in relative-to-metric alignment. We introduce an eight-dataset zero-shot benchmark across diverse scenes, materials, and sensors. Across these benchmarks, UA-Depth achieves the best mean rank among representative baselines, with particularly strong gains on datasets dominated by transparent and reflective objects. Beyond depth metrics, we demonstrate downstream improvements in category-level 6D pose estimation and 6D grasp synthesis by exploiting the predicted uncertainty. \emph{Code, models, and data for training and evaluation will be released upon publication.}

AI.brief_summary: 提出 UA-Depth，一个在透明、反射、半透明材质下迭代联合精修深度与像素级不确定性的深度复原框架，用不确定性门控特征抑制不可靠线索，并借助冻结深度基础模型先验与两阶段尺度归一化提升零样本表现，还构建了八数据集零样本基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「状态与逐像素不确定性共同迭代更新、并在下游任务中使用不确定性」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、不可靠区域降权及基于置信度的停止决策提供可核查借鉴，但并非 latent 推理研究。

title: dKV Forcing: Separating Generation and Memory Representations through a Differentiable KV Cache
summary: A causal video generator produces two key--value (KV) states for every segment: the KV it uses while denoising that segment, and the KV it writes into the cache for later segments to read. In a pretrained generator the two already differ substantially, later segments attend to them differently, and replacing the written KV with the generation KV degrades the continuation. We propose dKV Forcing (dKV denotes differentiable KV) to learn a dedicated memory representation from its future use: a writer-specific low-rank residual on the shared backbone separates memory writing from generation and is trained through the future reads of what it writes. Learning a write from its future use needs gradients through the cache, which the mutable cache in common use cannot provide. dKV Forcing replaces the training-time cache by persistent differentiable pages with local rematerialization and, in one temporal traversal, computes exactly the gradient that a two-pass reconstruction of the same objective computes. One traversal computes the full memory gradient at $7\%$ generator-update overhead over detached-write training, with $28\%$ less resident memory and $20.8\%$ shorter training cycles than the two-pass reconstruction. Over Self Gradient Forcing (SGF), the same objective trained with the same traversal, writer adaptation raises VBench-Long aesthetic quality by $6.6$ points at 60\,s and $8.5$ points at 240\,s with the highest subject and background consistency, and rollout dropout of the residual keeps most of this gain while restoring the motion of training without write gradients.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对因果视频生成器，指出去噪所用的 KV 与写入缓存供后续片段读取的 KV 应视为不同表示，提出 dKV Forcing：用写入者专属低秩残差分离记忆写入与生成，并通过可微的持久化缓存页在单次时序遍历中取得「由未来读取定义写入」的精确梯度。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽属视频生成而非 VLM 推理，但其「区分生成用状态与记忆用状态、并按后续使用反传训练写入」的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的贡献分配与跨步监督提供可核查线索。

title: GatedVLA with Camera-Based Emergency Braking: AlpaSim E2E Closed Loop Challenge Technical Report
summary: This report presents GatedVLA, our entry for the Physical AI AV (PAI-AV) track. Our learned vision-language-action (VLA) policy pairs the driving-pretrained Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B vision-language model with a layer-wise flow-matching action expert that outputs a 2.5 s horizon of acceleration and curvature controls, augmented with a soft visual mask applied to the expert's cross-attention. Compared to an identically trained baseline, the masked policy achieves comparable overall open-loop error while reducing error on left turns. In local closed-loop evaluation across the same 150 scenes (two rollouts per scene), the visual mask increases the mean scene score from 0.479 to 0.517 (paired difference +0.038, 95% bootstrap CI [-0.018, +0.093], wins/losses 37/26, sign test p = 0.21). Incorporating a rule-based automatic emergency braking (AEB) module at deployment further increases the mean score to 0.599 (+0.082, CI [+0.023, +0.143]) and reduces the mean number of scenes with at-fault collisions from 34.0 to 11.0.

AI.brief_summary: 该技术报告提出 GatedVLA：以驾驶预训练的 Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B 为视觉语言主干，接层间 flow-matching 动作专家输出 2.5 秒的加速度与曲率控制，并在专家的 cross-attention 上施加软视觉掩码，在开环误差与 150 场景闭环评分上与该掩码的有无做对照，另在部署时叠加规则式 AEB。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「对动作专家 cross-attention 施加软视觉掩码」提供了关于 VLM 内部视觉证据如何被下游读取、以及屏蔽视觉通道对子类行为影响的对照线索，可供核查是否对应 LVR 中的视觉旁路与视觉证据筛选问题；但输出为驾驶控制而非 latent 推理状态，迁移性待评估。

title: SPAR: Experience-Driven Strategy Evolution in Multi-Session B2B Sales
summary: B2B outbound sales involves high transaction values and relationship-based trust, so closing a deal typically requires multiple rounds of outreach building on prior context. Existing LLM-based sales agents operate within single sessions and cannot carry forward context or refine strategies from experience. Methods that do learn from experience store lessons as unstructured text and treat all outcomes as equally informative, with no mechanism to distinguish a flawed strategy from an external factor. We propose SPAR, a self-evolving framework that models selling strategies as testable hypotheses and refines them without parameter updates. A double-loop architecture lets an inner loop adapt to individual merchants through episodic memory while an outer loop evolves a shared strategy playbook through causal attribution and hypothesis-driven evolution. In a live A/B test on the 1688 platform with over 200,000 merchants, SPAR achieves +15.8% conversion lift and +35.8% high-intent merchant growth. Human evaluation by domain experts rates SPAR at 4.62 out of 5 on overall sales quality, the highest among all methods.

AI.brief_summary: SPAR 将 B2B 销售策略建模为可检验假设，用内循环情景记忆适配单个商家、外循环借助因果归因演化共享策略手册，在 1688 平台 20 万商家 A/B 测试中报告转化提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其区分「策略缺陷」与「外部因素」的因果归因及跨会话经验累积，可能为 LVR 中轨迹贡献分配与内部状态信息保留的核查提供线索，但非视觉推理研究。

title: Restoring Semantic Fidelity for Training-Free High-Resolution Image Generation in Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-based text-to-image models have recently achieved remarkable success in image synthesis. However, when directly applied beyond their training resolution, these models often suffer from severe semantic degradation, where meaningful semantic content disappears. Although existing training-free high-resolution generation methods can mitigate this issue, the inherent semantic degradation at high resolutions remains largely unresolved, leading to degraded fine-grained details. Furthermore, widely used structural guidance methods lack modeling of the structure and details in the intermediate trajectory, which degrades the quality of the generated results. In this paper, we propose a training-free framework for high-resolution image generation to address these challenges. First, we propose a text-visual scale-decoupled attention (TVSDA) module, which restores the model's ability to generate semantically meaningful content at high resolutions by preserving the global receptive field of text tokens while aligning the receptive field of image tokens with the training resolution. Second, we propose a structure-detail guidance (SDG) strategy that explicitly models structural information and fine details through scale-wise and temporal-wise guidance, overcoming the limitations of conventional low-resolution guidance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly improves both structural coherence and detail fidelity over existing training-free DiT-based high-resolution generation approaches. The code is available at https://github.com/ljjcoder/Restoring-Semantic-Fidelity.

AI.brief_summary: 针对 DiT 文本到图像模型超出训练分辨率后出现的语义退化，提出免训练高分辨率生成框架：用文本-视觉尺度解耦注意力（TVSDA）保留文本 token 的全局感受野，同时让图像 token 感受野对齐训练分辨率，并以结构-细节引导（SDG）在尺度与时间维度上建模结构与细节。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「尺度解耦注意力 + 感受野对齐以抑制语义内容消失」的做法，可能为 LVR 中分辨率或序列长度变化时视觉内容在内部状态中的保真、以及注意力结构对 latent 表征的影响提供可供核查的线索，但原文面向图像生成，不涉及推理过程。

title: MemHarmBench: Evaluating Cross-Session Prompt Injection in Memory-Persistent AI Agents
summary: AI agents often rely on persistent memory to retain user preferences and operational rules across sessions. However, this capability introduces a new safety risk: malicious instructions from messages, documents, or Web content can be retained in memory and influence future tasks even after the original attack content is removed. Existing attack success metrics, however, fail to capture who is affected and how attacks translate into downstream harm during otherwise normal task execution. We introduce MemHarmBench, a victim-centric benchmark for evaluating cross-session prompt injection in memory-persistent AI agents. MemHarmBench considers three categories of potential victims: users, workspace/project owners, and external stakeholders. Our evaluation first exposes an agent to malicious instructions and tests whether they are retained in memory. We then remove the attack content and initiate a new session with a legitimate task while preserving the agent's memory. We jointly evaluate whether the agent follows the attacker's intent, completes the legitimate task, and exhibits observable execution anomalies. Across multiple agent systems, we find that cross-session attacks can remain behaviorally stealthy: agents often complete tasks normally and exhibit no detectable anomalies while still making critical decisions aligned with the attacker's intent. By connecting malicious memory retention to downstream decisions and affected parties, MemHarmBench provides a systematic framework for exposing safety risks that conventional attack- and task-success metrics may overlook. We publicly release MemHarmBench at https://github.com/Kirito14IT/MemHarmBench.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MemHarmBench，一个以受害方为中心的跨会话提示注入基准：先让 agent 接触恶意指令并检验其是否被写入持久记忆，再移除攻击内容、在新会话中执行正常任务，联合评估是否遵循攻击者意图、是否完成任务以及是否出现可见异常。
AI.relevance_reason: 「先植入、再移除、保留记忆执行正常任务」的评测把状态存留与其对下游决策的实际影响分开，可能可供核查 latent 内容是否真正参与答案生成，以及任务成功指标掩盖隐性影响的问题。

title: RSI-Env: An Open-Ended Environment for Recursive Self-Improvement of Agents
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) envisions agent systems that autonomously improve their own models and harnesses, with each updated system continuing to improve itself. Existing approaches typically restrict optimization objectives, editable components, or evaluation procedures, limiting open-ended exploration and continuity across generations. We introduce RSI-Env, a persistent environment for coordinated model-harness improvement, supporting autonomous training, harness modification, and retention of research state. An independent Host Controller manages services, evaluation, and versioning. Under Self, each accepted model-harness version takes over the next improvement round. We define three settings that vary goal specificity and access to benchmark feedback: Open-General, Capability-Directed, and Benchmark-Guided. Across these three settings, we compare Self with two fixed external Teachers on seven tasks, starting from Qwen3.8-27B with a minimal harness. Without benchmark feedback, Open-General Self raises GPQA Diamond accuracy from 65.2% to 73.2% and AIME 2026 accuracy from 53.3% to 56.7%. All three Capability-Directed Self runs achieve target-aligned gains. Knowledge Self demonstrates continued improvement across system updates, with SimpleQA accuracy rising from 82.0% to 85.0% and then 88.0%. Benchmark guidance and Teacher benefits vary by task. These results demonstrate RSI-Env's support for open-ended exploration and sustained recursive improvement within the studied runs, while highlighting challenges in preserving gains across capabilities.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RSI-Env：一个带独立 Host Controller（负责服务、评测与版本管理）的持久化环境，让被接受的「模型+harness」版本接管下一轮自我改进，并在三种目标设定下与固定外部 Teacher 在七个文本推理任务上比较改进幅度与代际延续性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其对 harness（含工具、评测与流程）的自动改写与代际保留，或许可供核查如何搜索和固化 VLM 推理期脚手架（如取证据与停止规则）；但不涉及视觉状态或 latent 表示，是否触及测试时计算控制需读原文确认。

title: Evolving Memory, Learning to Meta-Control: Test-Time Adaptation for Experience-augmented LLM Agents
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to ACL Rolling Review (October 2026)
summary: Self-evolving agents accumulate experience from task streams, but existing frameworks typically rely on fixed pipelines to retrieve and utilize this experience, neglecting when and how to deploy it. We introduce Online Meta-Control of Experience (OMCE), a framework that updates experience memory and learns a meta-control policy from task feedback during test-time adaptation. OMCE employs a lightweight contextual-bandit meta-controller that uses compact retrieval signals to select among four cognitive actions: DIRECT, EPISODE, GUIDE, and DISTILL. This routing mechanism operationalizes three coupled decisions: whether to invoke experience, which memory format to utilize, and when to consolidate new guidance. OMCE evolves online, leveraging task feedback to update the memory bank and refine the routing policy via contextual bandit updates. Experiments on four online adaptation benchmarks across four backbones show that OMCE improves first-attempt success by up to 20.5 percentage points over the strongest compared baseline, while reducing per-task token use by a factor of 5.7 to 62.5 relative to ACE with GPT-5.2. Controlled ablations further support the benefits of learned routing and continued routing policy adaptation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 OMCE，在测试时用轻量 contextual bandit 元控制器依据检索信号在 DIRECT、EPISODE、GUIDE、DISTILL 四种认知动作间路由，并据任务反馈在线更新经验记忆与路由策略，在多个在线适应基准上提升首次成功率并大幅降低 token 消耗。
AI.relevance_reason: 其元控制器以紧凑信号学习「何时调用经验、用哪种记忆格式」，可能为 LVR 中是否检索视觉证据、何时合并与停止的决策策略提供可核查的借鉴线索，但论文本身不涉及视觉输入或 latent 状态。

title: FinishStrong: Learning to End Well after Imperfect Start in Video Temporal Grounding
summary: A poor start lowers the ceiling, but does not negate the value of finishing well. In autoregressive video temporal grounding, models systematically exhibit an endpoint performance asymmetry, predicting ends significantly worse than starts. A committed flawed start acts as an immutable physical constraint, irreversibly capping the attainable overlap as a sunk loss. While models should minimize the remaining conditional regret, standard post-training paradigms fail to teach this adaptation. Specifically, teacher-forced SFT suffers from strict prefix exposure bias, and holistic trajectory evaluation in standard GRPO inadvertently penalizes conditionally optimal ends if they follow a poor start. To address this, we introduce FinishStrong, a novel two-stage post-training framework explicitly designed to teach optimal continuations. First, Online-start SFT exposes the end prediction to the model's own generated contexts. Second, Conditional-tree GRPO restructures the sampling topology, centering end rewards exclusively within the same-start branch to mathematically isolate the conditional end quality from the inherited start penalty. FinishStrong-9B achieves a state-of-the-art 61.7\% overall IoU on TimeLens-Bench, remarkably outperforming flagship closed-source models like Gemini-3.8-Flash and Qwen3.8-Max. Crucially, when forced to continue from imperfect starts, it reduces the subsequent end prediction error by 36.5\%, proving its exceptional ability to end well after flawed starts. Code will be open.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对自回归视频时序定位中「结尾预测显著差于起点」的不对称现象，提出两阶段后训练框架 FinishStrong：用 Online-start SFT 让结尾预测接触模型自生成上下文，并用 Conditional-tree GRPO 将结尾奖励限制在同一起点分支内，以隔离起点造成的惩罚。
AI.relevance_reason: 「坏起点不可更改下最小化条件遗憾」及同分支奖励隔离，可供核查 LVR 中轨迹训练的信用分配与不良中间状态下的停止决策，但研究对象是可读的时间戳输出而非内部 latent 状态，联系需进一步确认。

title: Spectral Signatures of Memorization Basins in Diffusion Trajectories
summary: Diffusion models are known to reproduce individual examples from their training data as a form of memorization with implications for generalization, privacy, and downstream use. Recent work demonstrated that memorized training samples reside inside contiguous regions of the data/latent space known as basins of memorization -- once a denoising trajectory enters a basin, under finite perturbations it irreversibly reproduces a memorized example. Prior empirical work on such basins in trained models has primarily focused on classifier-free guidance based detection and mitigation strategies in text-to-image models, leaving basin entry and their formation largely uncharacterized. In this paper, we present a geometric characterization of memorization basins for conditional, unconditional, and rectified-flow-based diffusion models. We observe a characteristic signature in the local spectrum of the function geometry that distinguishes basin entry: the emergence of a dominant singular mode followed by a sharp spectral recovery. This signature appears at two timescales: along denoising trajectories during inference and over the course of training. We further investigate whether these geometric signatures can be used to intervene on memorization. During training, we suppress memorization by acting on the dominant mode. At inference, we develop methods to identify trajectories entering memorization basins and steer them away. We find that these interventions remain effective even with low-dimensional approximations of the underlying geometry, and demonstrate that geometry-informed steering extends to large-scale text-to-image diffusion models. Together, our results corroborate that local spectral geometry provides a common basis for characterizing memorization and for suppressing, detecting, and steering away from it across training and generation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文对条件、无条件及 rectified-flow 扩散模型的「记忆盆地」做几何刻画，发现轨迹进入盆地时局部谱几何会出现主导奇异模突起继而谱快速恢复的特征，并据此在训练期抑制记忆、在推理期检测并引导轨迹离开。
AI.relevance_reason: 其沿生成轨迹监测局部谱几何、识别状态进入某区域并施加干预的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态轨迹的行为模式检测与引导提供方法线索，但研究对象是图像生成中的记忆而非多模态推理，可迁移性需核查。

title: OCBI: Order-Sensitive Cross-Branch Interaction for Image Manipulation Localization
summary: Image manipulation localization combines semantic structure with forensic traces to identify modified pixels. Within-branch spatial mixing and RGB-guided cross-branch mixing can produce different messages when composed in opposite orders. We propose OCBI, an extension of Co-Transformers that models the discrepancy between these two composition orders for localization. A local cross-branch fusion module uses the commutator of RGB-guided cross-attention and forensic self-attention to add a learnable signed correction to feature transfer. Pixelwise adaptive multiscale aggregation then combines spatial contexts before prediction. OCBI uses the Co-Transformers backbone and supervision. We compare OCBI with retrained Co-Transformers using CASIA-only task training, a 50-epoch budget, and final-epoch evaluation. Across five clean test datasets, OCBI achieves a macro PixelF1 of 0.5773, exceeding the baseline by 0.43 percentage points. Under JPEG compression, Gaussian blur, and resizing on three datasets, its average PixelF1 over 21 dataset-transformation conditions exceeds the baseline by 0.95 percentage points.

AI.brief_summary: 针对图像篡改定位，论文在 Co-Transformers 骨干上提出 OCBI，用 RGB 引导交叉注意力与取证自注意力的交换子建模两种组合顺序的差异，并加入可学习的有符号修正，再配合逐像素自适应多尺度聚合做预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文关注跨分支与自注意力复合顺序不可交换所带来的表征差异，与 LVR 中「先看后想」或「先想后看」的 latent 状态更新顺序是否等价、能否显式建模其差异这一问题可能有方法借鉴，可供核查；但任务本身为纯视觉取证定位，无推理过程研究。

title: RIFT: Residual-Informed Flow Transfer for One-Step Generative Video Compression
summary: Recent advances in video generation have enabled generative video compression to reconstruct details lost during coding using pretrained spatiotemporal priors. However, a substantial gap remains between codec-induced degradation and the perturbation trajectories learned by flow-matching models. In this paper, we identify a compression-dependent directional mismatch that degradation-strength-based timestep calibration alone cannot resolve. Compressed latents remain strongly aligned across codec operating points, while their reconstruction residuals vary substantially in magnitude and direction. To bridge this gap, we propose RIFT, a Residual-Informed Flow Transfer framework for one-step generative video compression. At its core, RIFT introduces a Residual Geometry Inducer (RGI) that converts the pretrained flow prediction into a content-adaptive restoration update using decoder-visible codec cues. RGI integrates flow-timestep conditioning with a learned full-band residual-strength estimate and content-conditioned direction and gain modulation, aligning the orientation and magnitude of the update with the compression-dependent residual geometry. Extensive experiments on three public video compression benchmarks show that RIFT outperforms competing generative video compression methods. The code is publicly available on RIFT.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究生成式视频压缩，提出 RIFT 框架：用残差几何诱导器把预训练 flow 预测改造成内容自适应的单步复原更新，通过方向与增益调制对齐压缩残差的几何结构。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以残差几何校准预训练 flow 的方向与幅度、实现单步状态更新」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的更新方式与残差对齐监督提供线索；但任务属视频压缩、不涉及视觉推理，迁移可行性需核查。

title: ReFrame: Silence-Aware Compute Reclamation for Full-Duplex Speech Models
summary: Full-duplex speech models execute dense model inference for every audio frame throughout a live interaction. This uniform framewise schedule creates sustained GPU load across dialogue states whose computation has strong, reusable temporal structure. ReFrame formulates full-duplex inference as a silence-aware computation problem. Mutual Silence Speculation (MSS) operates when both participants are silent: it evaluates multi-frame Temporal continuations, verifies text and hidden-state stability, and applies batched Mimi audio-token correction. Listening Frame Folding (LFF) operates while the user speaks and the agent listens: it processes already-arrived user frames through parallel Temporal execution and frame-batched audio-token generation while accepting only the verified prefix. Frame-Budget Reinvestment (FBR) assigns the released frame intervals to resumable external retrieval and language-model workers, then injects timely references through Moshi's conditioning interface. We instantiate ReFrame on five full-duplex models spanning Moshi-family, phase-structured, and flattened autoregressive generation. Across the complete 1,225-conversation FDBench, ReFrame reduces measured GPU execution time by 18.80-31.01% and retains 96.92-100% non-PAD text agreement on five different models. On HaluEval tests, FBR increases the number of correct generated spoken answers from 86 to 205 under the same auxiliary-service budget. ReFrame turns recurring dialogue structure into lower inference cost and higher end-to-end service capability.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ReFrame，把全双工语音模型的逐帧密集推理重新表述为静音感知的计算问题：在双方静音时做多帧连续推测并校验文本与隐藏状态稳定性，在用户说话时并行处理已到达帧且只接受已验证前缀，并把释放的帧预算转投外部检索与语言模型工作。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「多帧推测＋隐藏状态稳定性校验＋仅接受已验证前缀」的机制，可供核查作为 latent 推理轨迹的验证、提前停止与计算回收线索；但该工作是语音对话推理加速，未涉及视觉证据或 LVR 状态生成，迁移性属推测。

title: Self-Evolving Agentic Workflows via Semantic Decomposition of Complex Tasks
comment: Accepted as a Spotlight at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Interpreting Agent Behavior (IAB), GLEE Competition Track; 1st place in the GLEE competition. 21 pages
summary: Agentic workflows organize complex tasks into reusable procedures. However, invoking an LLM at every step incurs repeated inference costs and delays. We propose a framework for self-evolving agentic workflows through semantic task decomposition. Each subtask has explicit applicability conditions and a procedure that executes code or invokes a model as needed. An agent uses execution feedback to refine the decomposition and update these procedures. Experiments in the GLEE competition show the framework on bargaining, negotiation and persuasion. Most observed final-decision procedures are implemented in code. Code is available at https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/NeurIPS2026_SeaFlow.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出一种自演化 agentic workflow 框架：将复杂任务按语义分解为带显式适用条件的子任务，每个子任务由代码或模型调用执行，并利用执行反馈迭代改进分解与流程；在 GLEE 竞赛的谈判、议价与说服任务上验证，多数最终决策步骤由代码实现。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理主线无直接关系，但其「适用条件 + 代码或模型路由」的分解方式可供核查是否能为 LVR 的按需计算、模块化状态组织与何时调用的决策提供结构线索。

title: Z-Cache: Accelerating Diffusion Transformers via Self-Reflection
summary: Diffusion transformers have become the most powerful models for visual generation, but still suffer from massive computation costs. To solve this problem, feature caching has been proposed to cache the features of diffusion models in the previous computation steps and then reuse them in the following caching steps, which brings significant acceleration but also degradation in generation quality. To address this problem, this paper proposes Z-cache as a feature caching method that can maintain high-quality generation through self-reflection. Concretely, we observe that the error from feature caching tends to be sharply reduced after each full computation. Based on this observation, Z-Cache is designed to first predict the features in the future caching steps and then perform a full computation. After that, Z-Cache returns to the caching steps and re-predicts them based on the previous and the current computation steps, which brings correction in features. Experiments demonstrate that with Z-Cache, diffusion transformers achieve comparable generation quality to the original model but with faster inference speed, for instance, 6.22X acceleration on FLUX-dev for text-to-image generation. Our code is released on GitHub.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Z-Cache，一种用于扩散 Transformer 视觉生成的特征缓存加速方法：先预测后续缓存步的特征并做一次完整计算，再回到这些步依据前后计算重预测以校正特征。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「低成本预测—周期性全计算—回溯校正」的误差控制范式，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态的近似更新、漂移校正及 THINK/LOOK 的计算预算分配可供核查，但论文本身面向生成加速而非多模态推理。

title: Missingness-Aware Prior-Data Fitted Network for Irregular Clinical Time-Series
summary: Clinical time series are irregularly observed with laboratory measurements recorded at uneven intervals and observation patterns often reflecting patient state, clinical concern, and site-specific practice. Consequently, missingness is not merely a nuisance factor but an informative signal for prediction. We propose a Missingness-Aware Prior-Data Fitted Network (MA-PFN) for irregular clinical time-series prediction. MA-PFN first learns a diffusion-based prior over joint laboratory value and observation-mask trajectories from source-domain electronic health records, capturing both physiological dynamics and measurement processes. Synthetic trajectories sampled from this prior are then transformed into context-query tasks to train a PFN-style conditional predictor. Once trained, the model performs prediction for new admissions in a single forward pass, requiring neither retraining nor parameter adaptation on target datasets. The framework naturally supports both imputation and forecasting through different context-query constructions. We conduct internal validation on a held-out MIMIC-III test set and external validation on eICU, evaluating both imputation and forecasting and assessing cross-domain generalization under shifts in patient populations, clinical practices, and observation mechanisms. MA-PFN achieves the best performance across all evaluated settings, with Overall/Macro nRMSD ranging from (0.193/0.186) for internal imputation to (0.297/0.297) for external forecasting, without target-domain adaptation. These results demonstrate that learning missingness-aware task priors enables accurate and transferable clinical time-series prediction under informative missingness.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MA-PFN：先用扩散模型在源域 EHR 上学习化验值与观测掩码轨迹的联合先验，再采样合成轨迹构造 context-query 任务训练 PFN 式条件预测器，实现无需目标域适配的单次前向插补与预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「生成式先验采样合成轨迹以监督条件预测器」可供核查作为 LVR 中轨迹训练与任务先验构造的借鉴；把缺失掩码当作信息性证据信号的思路，也可能对应视觉证据缺失与筛选的建模。

title: Learning-to-Memorize: Dynamic Context Management for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive video generation has achieved impressive results on short clips, yet generating long videos remains challenging due to error accumulation over extended horizons, where each predicted frame depends on potentially imperfect previous frames. Existing approaches typically rely on static context management strategies, such as sliding-window caches that discard early frames or fixed sink frames that permanently preserve initial content. These designs either lose critical long-range context or anchor generation to outdated information, which can lead to degraded fidelity, motion stagnation, and reduced diversity. In this paper, we propose Learning to Memorize (L2M), a learned context memory management framework that dynamically retains, evicts, and evolves historical frames according to predicted importance. The framework consists of an importance prediction router that estimates the relevance of each historical frame, degradation-aware training that improves robustness to noisy or corrupted context, and a dynamic memory initialization and evolution mechanism that updates long-term memory using exponential moving average (EMA) importance scores. This allows high-quality frames to replace stale anchors and enables memory to adapt naturally to scene evolution. Trained with a teacher-student distillation objective and sparsity regularization, L2M makes efficient use of a fixed KV-cache budget while preserving the most informative contextual information. Extensive experiments demonstrate that L2M improves long-horizon video generation quality and temporal consistency over existing baselines, providing a learned strategy for context memory management in long autoregressive video generation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 L2M，用学习到的重要性路由器动态保留、淘汰和更新自回归视频生成中的历史帧 KV 记忆，并结合退化感知训练与 EMA 记忆演化，在固定缓存预算下提升长视频质量与时序一致性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按学习重要性筛选并演化 KV 记忆的做法，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、固定预算下的 latent 状态更新及缓存/位置影响提供方法线索，但需核查重要性预测能否迁移到多模态推理。

title: Quantizing Recurrent Language Models Is Easier Than You Think
summary: Linear recurrences are becoming an increasingly common building block in large language models, replacing the growing KV cache of softmax attention with a fixed-size recurrent state that enables efficient decoding. However, the quantization stack has largely been developed around softmax Transformers, whose numerical properties and inference state differ from those of recurrent models. Our goal is to understand these differences and study the design space of quantization methods for recurrent models. In our analysis, we differentiate between two targets. First, extra-state quantization concerns weights and activations outside the recurrent state, whose distributions are shaped indirectly by the sequence mixer during training. In controlled 1.3B parameter models, we find that decayed recurrences develop weaker residual outlier channels than softmax attention and are therefore easier to quantize without incoherence processing. Second, intra-state quantization concerns the recurrent state itself during decode, where repeated updates create a different numerical problem from KV cache quantization. We instantiate our findings as LoReS, a state quantization pipeline combining value-axis scale grouping to match output channel magnitude, decay-based mixed-precision to protect slowly decaying heads or channels, and stochastic rounding to limit error accumulation under repeated requantization. Across Qwen-3.5 9B, Nemotron-H 8B, and Kimi-Linear 48B-A3B, LoReS supports robust 8-bit state quantization and lower effective precision on shorter decode horizons. We implement LoReS in vLLM and demonstrate end-to-end decode speedups.

AI.brief_summary: 研究线性循环语言模型的量化设计空间，区分循环状态之外的权重/激活量化与解码时循环状态自身的量化，发现衰减型循环的残差离群通道弱于 softmax 注意力、更易量化，并提出 LoReS（值轴分组缩放、按衰减的混合精度、随机舍入）实现 8-bit 状态量化与端到端解码加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 其针对循环状态反复更新下误差累积的量化设计（衰减驱动的混合精度、随机舍入）可能为 latent 推理状态的数值保真与信息坍缩提供可供核查的方法线索，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理。

title: Online Active Learning Architecture for Safety-Critical Control Systems
summary: The transition of information-centric artificial intelligence to safety-critical applications is impeded by the limitations of conventional offline-training paradigms in open-world environments. This paper presents Control AI, an architecture for Online Active Learning (OAL) inspired by the continuous Prediction-Evaluation-Correction process of biological intelligence. The framework combines the hierarchical representation capacity of deep neural networks with the real-time error-feedback adaptation of adaptive control. A prediction model maps sensory input into a latent manifold, an optional latent model represents transitions in that space, and a reconstruction model maps the latent state back to observable signals. Residuals between predictions and measurements provide the internal learning signal. Spatial and temporal cross-reconstruction architectures prevent OAL from collapsing to a trivial identity mapping, while coupled, dual, and localized variants shorten error-transmission paths. Localized predictive coding style OAL is implemented through guidance-backpropagation and target-backpropagation architectures, and hybrid and scaled variants support high-dimensional deployment. The paper focuses on the architectural rationale and the progression from a conceptual feedback loop to practical large-scale configurations.

AI.brief_summary: 提出名为 Control AI 的在线主动学习架构：预测模型把传感输入映射到 latent manifold，可选的 latent 转移模型刻画该空间中的状态演化，重构模型再映射回可观测信号，预测与测量之间的残差作为内部学习信号，并用时空交叉重构与局部化预测编码变体避免退化为恒等映射。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽属安全攸关控制而非多模态推理，其「交叉重构防止表征坍缩」与局部化预测编码的误差传导设计，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态的训练监督与信息坍缩问题。

title: Does reflective LLM feedback survive a wet-lab-scale label budget?
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Agentic AI for Biological Discovery Workshop. OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=ezGV5BIXVJ
summary: Can reflective language-model feedback improve a biological predictor when each cycle buys only one plate of labels? We separate three possible sources of benefit: proposing model edits, choosing measurements, and revising decisions through repeated feedback. We replay $36$ ProteinGym assays, starting with $96$ labels and acquiring $96$ per round for six rounds, with a sealed test set and a shared edit schema. The pre-specified comparison of full LLM control against random edits detects no advantage in test rank correlation ($Δz=-0.008$, $95\%$ CI $[-0.034,+0.018]$); equivalence is also unestablished. Exploratory ablations nevertheless identify useful model editing. With random acquisition fixed, LLM edits improve Fisher-transformed test Spearman by $0.043$ over no edits; with acquisition fixed to upper confidence bound, they improve normalized top-variant recovery by $0.023$. LLM acquisition alone does not detectably outperform fixed adaptive rules, and repeated feedback does not detectably outperform one initial recommendation under full control. Thus, the observed gains support constrained specialist editing, while the incremental value of recursive reflection remains unestablished at this label budget.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在36个ProteinGym assay上以初始96标签、每轮再采集96标签共六轮的预算，拆解反思式LLM反馈的三类可能收益来源（提出模型编辑、选择测量、重复反馈修订决策），预注册比较未发现全LLM控制优于随机编辑。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按组件隔离多轮反馈增益、并报告递归反思无可检测增量的设计，可供核查LVR中循环推理的收益归属与「重复反馈是否值得」问题，但生物预测任务需较多迁移。

title: Vision-language classification of Torsades de Pointes risk from pseudo-coloured ECG images: do T-wave morphology and colour context help or hinder?
summary: Contextual prompting is widely presented as a cheap route to better performance from vision models, but the evidence comes largely from benchmarks in which an attribute named in a prompt is also present in the image, confounding the two channels. We investigate the significance of context for a semantically complex biomedical signal classification task using a domain-adapted vision-language model, BiomedCLIP. Building on our previous work that renders electrocardiogram (ECG) signals as colour-enhanced images to flag Torsades de Pointes risk using the QT-nomogram and pseudo-colouring technique, we cross four context strategies with four T-wave morphology label sets, evaluated zero-shot and with a class-balanced linear probe, under five-fold stratified cross-validation on 9,789 images. Zero-shot inference is unusable. Once trained, the colour-enhanced images outperform the colourless ones on every metric: balanced accuracy 0.903 versus 0.825, sensitivity 0.914 versus 0.827, specificity 0.892 versus 0.823, ROC-AUC 0.955 versus 0.888 and Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) 0.437 versus 0.311. Crossing colour-in-image with colour-in-prompt separates the confounded channels: the image contributes +0.126 MCC (+0.078 balanced accuracy, +0.067 ROC-AUC) whether or not the prompt names colour, whereas naming it changes nothing under any metric. Context is two-sided: the best prompt set gains 0.008 MCC where colour is present and 0.016 where it is not, while the worst loses 0.017 and 0.013. For a signal rendered as an image, the leverage lies in how the signal is drawn rather than in how it is described - and where the endpoint is an interval measurement, prompts naming T-wave morphology describe the wrong quantity.

AI.brief_summary: 该研究用 BiomedCLIP 对伪彩色心电图图像做尖端扭转型室速风险分类，交叉四种上下文提示与四种 T 波形态标签，在零样本和线性探针下比较颜色渲染与提示描述的作用。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把「图像中的颜色」与「提示中的颜色」解耦的设计，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据是否被实际使用、语言先验是否旁路视觉；但任务并非 latent 生成式推理，迁移需较多核查。

title: Is Your Long-Horizon Benchmark Really Deep? Measuring and Synthesizing Depth in Terminal Tasks
summary: Long-horizon terminal tasks are used to evaluate and train agents. Human-curated datasets are scarce, so many synthesis methods have emerged. They usually measure the length of a task by the turns a model needs to pass it, and its difficulty by labels the LLM sets during generation. We find, however, that the turn count largely reflects the habits of the model, not only the demands of the task, and that the labels barely track how often models pass. We describe a terminal task by its work, the number of operations it requires, and its depth, the number of turns that must happen in sequence because the commands of each turn can only be chosen after reading the output of the previous one. Estimating depth as the smallest turn cap, stated to the agent, under which the task passes, we audit 734 tasks from six existing datasets. Synthesis has mostly added work, not depth: 94% of the solved synthetic tasks pass within three turns, yet depth, unlike the turn count, predicts difficulty beyond work. We propose DEPTH, in which a generation agent writes each task one segment at a time in a real software environment, carrying out each segment before writing it and starting the next from the state it leaves. Our 105 tasks exceed every audited dataset in depth and work, and none of six current models passes half of them. Fine-tuning Qwen3-8B on runs from these tasks improves it on two terminal benchmarks.
